materialItemsExtracted: Julian Sayin earned a 93.1 clean-pocket passing grade, 12.8 YPA and 0.83 EPA/play in Week 1; two of his four pressured dropbacks became sacks, a tiny-sample pressure sensitivity worth monitoring against Texas.

Arch Manning earned a 90.7 passing grade, 0.87 EPA/play, three big-time throws against one turnover-worthy play, and was productive on four pressured dropbacks; this is encouraging but came against an overmatched Texas State defense.
Both quarterbacks faced pressure on only about 13-14% of Week 1 dropbacks, so Week 2 is the first meaningful test of whether the opener efficiency survives a major opponent upgrade.
